_doc: Default bounds of the regime design space (DESIGN.md section 9.1). Concentration axes marked from_domain take their default from the parameter set's ApplicabilityDomain when the optimiser builds the space; the numbers here are the fallback when no domain exists (literature entries) and the hard outer window the user may widen. Integer variables are drawn as floor(u * (hi - lo + 1)) + lo, clipped to [lo, hi]; offsets are counted down from n_ext - 1 and clipped to [0, n_ext - 1] per candidate. Units: stage counts dimensionless, ratios volumetric (O/A, S/A, W/A), concentrations mol/L except scrub_target_mM (mM), fractions dimensionless. Every candidate outside the recorded applicability intervals carries its OOD flags; nothing here is a chemical claim.

notes.n_scr, n_str: DESIGN 9.1 says 1-30 each; a scrub-free or strip-free cascade (n_scr = 0 or n_str = 0, allowed by 7.1) is a user widening of the lower bound, not a default
notes.scrub_target_mM: displacement scrub with the target metal (DESIGN 13.2: 0-50 mM)
notes.saponification_degree: 0-0.5; always flagged SAPONIFICATION_RANGE_UNKNOWN unless the entry records a studied range
notes.f_bleed: fraction of the organic replaced by fresh organic per pass, 0-0.1
notes.feed_dilution: volume of water added per volume of feed (0 = as received); dilution water enters water_L_h
notes.ligand_total_M: formal monomer concentration mol/L organic; the loader halves it for dimeric acidic extractants (DESIGN 1.1)

acidic_organophosphorus.notes: PC88A / Cyanex 272 placeholder concentration range of DESIGN 3.7 (0.2-1.5 M)

diglycolamide.notes: solvating: no saponification; TODGA corpus extractant range is 0.00023-0.3 M, working window 0.05-0.4 M
